node --test tests/visible.test.mjs && node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import * as y from './src/src/index.ts'
const cases = [
  '>
  	first
  last
',
  '>
  first
  	last
',
  '>
  first
  	middle
  last
',
  '>
  	' + 'tab words '.repeat(12) + '
  last
',
  '>
  ' + 'a'.repeat(22) + ' 	' + 'b'.repeat(25) + '
',
  '>
  first

  	last

',
  '|
  	first
  second
  	last
'
]
for (const source of cases) {
  const expected = y.load(source)
  const events = y.parseEvents(source, {})
  const docs = y.eventsToAst(events, { source, schema: y.CORE_SCHEMA })
  const rendered = y.present(docs, { schema: y.CORE_SCHEMA, lineWidth: 20 })
  assert.equal(y.load(rendered), expected, `round trip failed for ${JSON.stringify(source)}
${rendered}`)
  if (source.startsWith('>')) assert.match(rendered, /^>/, 'folded block style was not preserved')
  else assert.match(rendered, /^\|/, 'literal block style was not preserved')
  console.log('PASS', JSON.stringify(source), '=>', JSON.stringify(rendered))
}
EOF

final:
Updated `src/src/ast/presenter.ts` to treat leading tabs as more-indented in folded scalars, preventing extra line breaks and wrapping of tab-leading lines. Wrapping also now avoids breaking at a space followed by a tab.

Verification: `node --test tests/visible.test.mjs` passed all 7 tests with `SUFFICE_WORKSPACE` set to the workspace path. An additional 21-case parse → AST → present → load check passed across strip, clip, and keep chomping, including literal-style preservation.
